rebuild: gzip -dc sdk.rs.gz > sdk.rs  # sha256 must match sdk_sha256
rustc --edition=2024 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-name sdk --crate-type rlib -C opt-level=2 -Awarnings sdk.rs -o libsdk.rlib
rustc --edition=2024 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type cdylib -C opt-level=2 --extern sdk=libsdk.rlib guest.rs -o guest.wasm
node run.mjs <exact Text Core artifact.wasm> guest.wasm
deno run --allow-read run.mjs <exact Text Core artifact.wasm> guest.wasm
